title: Archaeologist who excavated Amenemhat III's pyramid called it a symbolic tomb for the ka

tellings.quote: the archaeologist, his name starts with a P, that excavated the the pyramid of Aminat III. um he asserted that this was never a tomb and that this was a symbolic tomb for this for the pharaoh's c.

plain: The pyramid of the pharaoh Amenemhat III was never a real tomb, says the archaeologist who dug it up in the 1800s, but a symbolic tomb for the pharaoh's ka, the life force or spirit double of Egyptian belief. Luke Caverns, a researcher of the pyramids, passes this on to Michels, though he recalls only that the archaeologist's name starts with a P. He tells it to back his case that the pyramids were not simply burial places.
